summary: Aligns backbone microservice transport and contract catalog roles with the architecture-boundaries gate so REST/gRPC/outbox composition crates can truthfully model inward dependencies without weakening kernel/domain boundaries.
claim_boundary: This change updates governance role metadata and the architecture-boundaries role matrix/tests. It claims local architecture-boundaries, catalog, format, and focused test pass. It does not claim production gateway deployment, live gRPC traffic, live REST serving, live outbox broker delivery, branch-protection success, or full oya verify green.

facets.F1_simplicity: Keeps the existing role-matrix validator and updates only role edges needed for outward REST/gRPC/adapter composition plus catalog roles that were previously over-literal suffix mappings.
facets.F2_correctness: The architecture-boundaries gate now recognizes grpc as a first-class transport role and API DTO crates used inward by domains/usecases are cataloged as domain contract crates rather than outward API facades.
facets.F3_architecture: Preserves forbidden inward-to-outward edges such as kernel-to-app and app-to-app while allowing clean-architecture outer adapters/transports to call inward usecase/app layers.
facets.F5_quality: Adds focused unit coverage for REST-to-usecase/app, gRPC transport composition, and adapter-to-usecase role edges.
facets.F7_security_privacy: No runtime data flow, authorization behavior, or secret handling changes are introduced; data-class ownership in catalog records is unchanged.
facets.F10_ci_cd: Turns the architecture-boundaries lane from failing to passing locally for the current workspace/catalog snapshot; broader local/remote CI non-green status remains separately recorded.
facets.F13_reversibility: Catalog role metadata and one validator matrix can be reverted without changing microservice business behavior.
